tds_codes_unverified.nature: Rent paid by an individual / HUF tenant not liable to tax audit
tds_codes_unverified.conflict: CanKC lists code 1007 for old Section 194IB but marks it 'inferred — not yet formally notified by CBDT, verify before use'. CA Gaurav Verma instead assigns code 1010 to 194IB. TDSGuru lists neither code. No agreement — do not use either number for a filing without checking TRACES / the official source.

tds_codes_unverified.nature: Purchase of immovable property from a resident (buyer deducts)
tds_codes_unverified.conflict: CanKC lists code 1010 for old Section 194IA but marks it 'inferred — verify before use'. CA Gaurav Verma assigns 1010 to 194IB and 1011 to 194IA instead. TDSGuru lists neither code. No agreement — do not use either number for a filing without checking TRACES / the official source.

tds_codes_unverified.nature: Contract / commission / professional fees paid by an individual / HUF not liable to tax audit

tds_codes_unverified.nature: Purchase of immovable property — payment code
tds_codes_unverified.conflict: The payment code for old Section 194IA is disputed: CanKC says 1010 (inferred), Gaurav Verma says 1011. TDSGuru does not list it. Shown here only so you know it is unresolved.

Only the TaxGST.in rate-chart PDF checked lists the full TCS code set (1068 liquor, 1069 tendu leaves, 1070–71 timber, 1072 forest produce, 1073 scrap, 1074 minerals, 1075 motor vehicle, 1076–85 luxury goods, 1086–87 LRS, 1088–89 tour packages, 1090 parking, 1091 toll, 1092 mine/quarry). Rates are corroborated by CA Gaurav Verma, but the code numbers themselves have only one full published source. Left out of phase 1; needs a second source before shipping.
No published source checked assigns any payment to code 1036. It appears to be unassigned in the 1001–1067 range. Listed here so the gap is visible, not hidden.
